summary: D' Physco-Bit.  A health monitoring app for astronauts. Allow astronauts to keep up with their recent health level and solve the health problems they met. Allow astronauts to have a safe journey out and back to Earth.
details: Monitor health for the astronauts according to the real life info for the astronauts' health. Astronauts can enter their health info and the app will show either the astronaut health level is align to the normal health level for an astronaut. Contains ai doctors which can suggest what to do if an astronaut has health problem. Allow all astronaut that travel to space to obtain a reference for their health condition. We use ai tools which is google ai studio to help us to develop this app. We use java language for our coding.
